dataset: Europe Offshore Wind Farms 40-Year Hourly Wind Speed and Electricity Production

rights_and_access.license: CC BY 4.0 according to the Figshare public API record
rights_and_access.attribution: The files contain modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (1980-2019); preserve the source attribution described in the README and dataset paper.
rights_and_access.download_route: Anonymous GET through the official Figshare downloader; no account, token or request form.

payload_reconciliation.official_description: 29 individual offshore farms, 350,640 hourly rows spanning 1980-01-01 00:00 UTC through 2019-12-31 23:00 UTC.
payload_reconciliation.observed_power_columns: An index, the 29 farm power series, and an extra `Total_Power` column.
payload_reconciliation.observed_wind_columns: An index plus the same 29 farm wind-speed series.
payload_reconciliation.pilot_columns: Only the 29 exactly matching farm-level power/wind column pairs were used. The extra aggregate `Total_Power` column was excluded from this per-farm screen.
payload_reconciliation.data_semantics: Power outputs are synthetic historical production signals generated from reanalysis weather and turbine power curves, not observed metered output.

task_protocol.task: 24-hour-ahead hourly synthetic power forecasting, one separate target per farm
task_protocol.inputs: 24 previous hourly power values and the corresponding 24 previous hourly wind-speed values for that farm (48 numeric inputs). No future wind/weather values or target-derived features are used.
task_protocol.target: Next 24 hourly power outputs for the same farm (24 network outputs).
task_protocol.split: Chronological row-order 70/15/15 split of the 350,640 source timestamps, with each complete 24-step target vector confined to its partition; a forecast window may use history from immediately before the partition boundary.
task_protocol.scaling: Per-feature-position input mean/std and scalar target mean/std fit on the training windows only; apply to validation/test unchanged.
task_protocol.baselines: Persistence repeats the final observed power value across 24 hours. Daily seasonal naive predicts the previous 24-hour power vector.
task_protocol.training: Repository TabularMLP; CUDA full training partition as one batch per epoch; Adam lr=0.001, MSE, 30 epochs; lowest-validation-MSE checkpoint evaluated once on held-out test.
task_protocol.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU, 6 GiB

capacity_and_difficulty.normalized_metric: RMSE/MAE divided by the standard deviation of the training target values.
capacity_and_difficulty.conclusion: No tested architecture saturates: test errors remain substantial, and wider capacity systematically changes held-out error. The widest network improves on both simple baselines for all 29 farm tasks.

limitations: Power is synthetic, not observed metered generation; the benchmark tests weather-to-power-curve time series rather than an operational utility forecast.
One chronological split and one seed per architecture were screened; results are provisional and do not certify robustness to alternative splits, seeds, or forecast horizons.
The aggregate Total_Power column was not screened as a separate task.
No ADP controller, full vanilla grid, or central runner integration was tested.
disposition: KEEP PROVISIONALLY as 29 individual, non-saturated 24-hour-ahead farm-level synthetic power forecasting tasks. Open license, anonymous complete retrieval, exact series matching, full-batch memory, three representative plain MLPs, chronological validation/test and baseline comparison all passed this screen. Preserve attribution to the dataset authors and modified Copernicus information.
